Hi Olivia — great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the procurement side so we can keep the POC on track:

Summary (2 lines):
- SolarGrid is excited to test Redwood for inference on edge telemetry alerts; expected spend for initial POC ~ $6k–8k over 30 days.
- Primary procurement question is payment method and vendor onboarding cadence (PO vs corporate card / marketplace).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm AP constraints (PO threshold, required forms, vendor setup SLA).
2) I’ll share our vendor onboarding packet and a short SOW draft for your procurement team to review.
3) If PO is required, we can generate an initial PO-ready invoice and align on net terms (typical customers use Net30).

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF), Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (DOCX)

Let me know if you prefer a short call with your AP lead — happy to join.

Thanks,

Thanks for the recap, Ava. A couple of clarifications from AP so we can scope the internal path: 

- For vendor onboarding we require a completed W-9 (US entity) and our standard vendor form (we can accept a vendor packet PDF).
- PO vs card: our AP policy prefers PO for amounts above $5,000. The PO process takes ~7–10 business days from vendor acceptance, unless the supplier is pre-approved on our marketplace.
- Marketplace: we are exploring using the CloudVendor Marketplace (it allows faster onboarding and auto-invoice), but that requires Redwood to be a listed supplier there — not sure of Redwood’s status.

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clarity. A few notes from Redwood finance and ops on options and timelines:

1) PO path (recommended for >$5k):
   - We can accept a company PO. Required documents from our side: signed SOW (attached) and vendor setup form (attached).
   - Typical turnaround on our vendor team to accept a PO is 2–3 business days once we receive the signed PO and vendor form.

2) Card path (fastest):
   - We accept corporate cards for one-off charges; for transactions above $10k we typically require pre-approval, but exceptions are possible.
   - If SolarGrid’s procurement policy allows a company card, the trial can start immediately after payment.

3) Marketplace option:
   - If Redwood is listed on CloudVendor Marketplace, onboarding and invoicing can be automated — this shortens AP processing to ~1–2 business days. I don’t believe we’re currently listed; I’ve flagged the Marketplace team to confirm.

Concrete next steps: 
- Olivia / AP: send the W-9 and confirm whether SolarGrid will issue a PO (Net30) or pay by card.
- Ava / Rishi: we’ll prepare a PO-ready invoice and a one-page SOW.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_SOW_v1.docx

Best,
Rishi Malhotra

Quick note from Redwood finance — we can accommodate either path. A few items to help expedite: 

- If SolarGrid issues a PO: please send the PO PDF to invoices@redwood.com and cc ben@redwood.com. We will apply Net30 unless otherwise agreed.
- If paying by corporate card: we can accept a one-time charge now; please confirm the card holder and amount, and we’ll generate a pro-forma invoice.
- Marketplace: if you want us to pursue enrollment on CloudVendor Marketplace, say the word and I’ll open the internal request (timeline ~2–3 business days to submit).

If anyone from AP needs a short call to walk through the vendor form, I’m available tomorrow morning.
